test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The extremists have assassinated the President.

options.text: The President has been assassinated by the extremists.
The President had been assassinated by the extremists.
The President is assassinated by the extremists.
The President was assassinated by the extremists.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **The President has been assassinated by the extremists.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the present perfect tense.
 
• Passive Voice sentences of Present Perfect Tense use “has/have” along with &am
